HyperChat is a product operated by STREAMHEART PRIVATE LIMITED. Contact us at ankit@hyperchat.space. These Terms govern the website, creator tools and audience interaction services, together with the Privacy Policy and Refund & Cancellation Policy.

You must be at least 18 years old to use HyperChat. Provide accurate account and onboarding information. Accepting these Terms does not replace any separate consent needed for personal data processing. Mandatory statutory rights prevail over a conflicting term. Additional creator or integration agreements apply only when properly disclosed and accepted.

The public website's fictional demonstrations do not submit real interactions or applications. Available production features depend on creator access, settings and rollout. We describe the actual service before you use or purchase it.

Keep credentials and private source links secure. Use the supported permissions for moderators instead of sharing passwords, and report suspected compromise promptly. Your responsibility for account security does not eliminate our own obligations.

Creator identity verification is performed by Didit. HyperChat receives completion status and does not store KYC identity documents, face images or biometric records. Our creator policy requires renewed KYC each Indian financial year, 1 April–31 March, with renewal timing communicated in advance. This is a HyperChat account requirement. The Privacy Policy explains status retention and the separate role of Didit. Applicable financial obligations remain.

Creators select the enabled interaction types and moderation settings. Text-to-speech reads typed text with a generated voice; a recorded voice message uses the viewer's own recording. Queue conditions, moderation and the broadcast affect whether and when an interaction is displayed. We do not promise personal attention, increased engagement or a particular audience outcome.

Do not submit content you lack authority to use, including private information or another person's voice recording. A selected interaction may be public on a live stream, replay or clip as explained before submission. Moderation decisions do not remove applicable remedies for a purchased service that was not supplied.

Do not use the service for unlawful harassment, threats, impersonation, fraud, malware, unauthorized access, privacy violations, or disruption. Do not bypass moderation, manipulate queues or misuse payment/refund systems. Requests for additional integrations or authorized access can be sent to ankit@hyperchat.space.

We may restrict content or access for documented safety, security, service or legal reasons. Action should be proportionate. Where feasible and lawful we give reasons and a review route; urgent protective action may occur first.

sections.title: 5. Content, personal data and platform rights

blocks.text: We own or license HyperChat's software, brand and original service materials. You retain rights you have in content you submit and grant only the permission needed to host, moderate, process and deliver the requested interaction, including broadcast exposure you authorize. This is not blanket permission for unrelated advertising, AI training, voice cloning or commercial reuse.

Personal data is not declared our exclusive property. Your statutory data rights remain. The Privacy Policy controls purposes, sharing, withdrawal and retention. The Privacy Policy describes currently indefinite interaction retention and planned 30-day media/90-day text availability limits. Automatic expiry and restricted archives are not yet deployed. These planned limits are not current deletion guarantees. The Privacy Policy explains restricted retention, including the one-year preservation requirement for covered personal data and processing logs where applicable law requires it, and separately required financial records. Such retention does not authorize routine reuse after the relevant service purpose or consent ends.

Do not disclose non-public credentials or other users' private event streams. Permitted OBS browser sources and integrations can use data necessary for their documented purpose. Genuine IP and security protections do not prohibit the normal service or waive statutory data rights. Additional access requires an agreed scope and safeguards. We do not impose automatic daily damages through these general Terms.

Payments are processed through a payment aggregator/gateway. Streamheart settles creator funds and keeps transaction IDs, amounts and payout records. HyperChat does not store payer details as payment records. Payment processing and settlement are not described as a service with no financial responsibilities.

Before payment, the responsible supplier and service, total amount, applicable fees/taxes, cancellation conditions and refund rules must be clearly shown. The payment flow identifies the provider. Any gateway authorization is the provider's; these Terms do not claim that Streamheart itself holds RBI payment authorization.

Creator settlement timing and applicable deductions must be set out in the creator agreement and records available to the creator. Lawful refunds, chargebacks, tax obligations or documented fraud/legal holds may require proportionate adjustments. We explain a hold and review route where permitted. We do not withhold earned settlements merely because a creator uses or switches to another platform.
Payment-provider terms do not remove Streamheart's obligations for its own service. The Refund & Cancellation Policy and mandatory law apply to refund requests.

Third parties may operate streaming platforms, OBS, payments, verification, voice generation, hosting or moderation integrations. Relevant provider/data information must be disclosed accurately at collection or feature activation. We remain responsible for our duties and for processors acting on our behalf. An independent provider's notice does not excuse a contradictory HyperChat promise.

Request account closure at ankit@hyperchat.space or through available account controls. Personal data is erased according to the Privacy Policy; necessary accounting or legally held records can remain with restricted use. Closure, withdrawal of consent and cancellation of a paid recurring service are distinct: we help identify and complete the requested actions rather than assume one means all.

We disclose any recurring service, renewal price, billing interval and cancellation method before purchase. We do not create a recurring obligation through these Terms alone. Access restriction does not automatically cancel an earned refund or settlement. Material service changes receive appropriate notice and legally required remedies.

We use reasonable care, but cannot promise uninterrupted or error-free service. Any service-level commitment must be expressly agreed; feature descriptions do not create an unstated uptime guarantee. Liability follows applicable law and any valid specific agreement. We do not exclude non-excludable consumer remedies, statutory privacy duties, fraud liability or other responsibilities law prevents us excluding.

Email ankit@hyperchat.space for account, service or refund concerns. Our support target is acknowledgement within 48 hours and resolution within 30 days, subject to shorter applicable legal requirements. Privacy rights and their escalation route are described in the Privacy Policy. Internal review does not waive recourse to a competent court, consumer commission, payment dispute process or regulator.

Indian law governs, subject to mandatory protections applicable to you. Competent forums retain their lawful jurisdiction; we do not remove statutory choices of forum. We give at least 14 days' advance notice of material changes, unless urgent legal or security reasons require an earlier change, subject to applicable obligations. Changes do not retrospectively create data consent. We obtain fresh consent where required and record the effective date of the adopted version.
